body: Signature edition. Signature-original methods and framings for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Runs coupled simulations across machines as one coordinated job. A distributed simulation orchestrator partitions coupled models, manages time synchronization (conservative/optimistic), and recovers from node failures. Real implementations use HLA/DIS federations, FMI co-simulation masters, and Ray/Dask task graphs. It balances load dynamically and checkpoints long runs.

Rank 1: name the tool's single core action (Conservative and optimistic time synchronization). Rank 3: run it once on a tiny input and check the output.
